what: The system cursor stays, and a 120px transparent ring follows late with .5s power3. Over a view target (list row or card) an 80px accent-color circle grows inside the ring from 0 to 1x on a .6s expo ease-out curve, and a short word (Open) appears .15s later. If the target has a name, 8.5px text repeating NAME • to fill the circumference fades in .1s later at .6 → 1x and rotates once around the circle every 9 seconds. When the cursor leaves the window it disappears in .3s.

options.targets: Target selector to watch, default [data-fx-part=view] — reads the target’s data-cursor-label (short text, default View) · data-cursor-name (name circling around it)
options.label: Text used when data-cursor-label is absent, default View
options.fill: Ring text character count — how many times the name repeats, default 34

from.where: All pages .cursor — Open + work name orbit over work list rows and cards

note: The original orbit text’s translucent black outline (shadow) was removed per the skin rules. Not applied on touch devices. With reduced motion the orbit does not spin and only the circle grows
